start: Member phone, Gym tab, a member still in the gym; the gym set 7 free days

user_sees: The card with the share link app.mettleup.fit/f/<CODE> and 'When a friend joins, your gym can add 7 free days to your plan.'
must_not: A new code on every open
Another member's code

steps.action: Share the link; the friend sends the form; the gym makes them a member
must_not: The friend's name or number shown to the member

start: Member phone, a member who left, or a suspended gym

user_sees: The card is not offered (LEFT or SUSPENDED)
must_not: A link that still works after leaving

start: Member phone, a friend's enquiry moves from open to joined, then the gym deletes it

user_sees: The count goes up on 'joined', and down if the enquiry is deleted
must_not: A count that includes friends who only asked

start: Member phone, the card after friends asked

user_sees: Only a number of friends who joined
must_not: Who asked or who joined

steps.action: Check what the friend's page shows of the member
must_not: The member's surname, number or plan

start: A friend opens the shared link on any phone or computer

user_sees: The gym's name and look, and the inviting member's first name
must_not: Any other member data

steps.action: Type name, mobile number, best time to train, and send (friend_invite_send)
user_sees: The page says it was sent; 'Only the gym sees your number.'
must_not: The number shown to the inviting member

steps.action: Send a one-letter name or a bad number
user_sees: BAD_NAME or BAD_PHONE in plain words
must_not: An enquiry made with a bad number

steps.action: Send a 6th form from the same link today, or the gym's 31st
must_not: Unlimited enquiries from one link

steps.action: Open a link from a member who left, or of a paused gym
user_sees: The page says the link stopped
must_not: The gym's name for a dead link

start: A friend whose number the gym already knows

steps.action: Send the form with a number already on the gym's list or in an open enquiry
user_sees: The page says it was sent, exactly as for a new number
must_not: The page telling a stranger the number belongs to a member
A second enquiry for the same number (0085: a note on the existing one instead)
Another gym, MettleUp marketing, or the inviting member seeing them

start: Admin app, Enquiries, after a friend sent the form

user_sees: The friend's enquiry: name, number, 'Best time to train: Evening', marked 'Referred by <member>', follow-up today
must_not: The enquiry missing until a manual reload

steps.action: Turn the enquiry into a member
user_sees: An offer to add the free days to the inviting member's plan, one tap
must_not: Free days added without the owner's tap

steps.action: Open Settings, Member app, Bring a friend (owner_friend_summary)
user_sees: Links made, friends who asked, friends who joined
must_not: Counts of another gym

start: Admin app, Settings, Bring a friend free days

user_sees: 'No free days for a friend who joins.' and the member's card shows no days
must_not: 61 days offered to members

steps.action: Mark it joined, then delete it
user_sees: The member's count goes up, then back down; the summary follows
must_not: The count stuck
The inviting member seeing the friend's number
